draft.description: I kept hundreds of Hindu texts as PDFs I could not search. This is how I built a searchable library from them, the two-gate check that caught broken text layers, and why the corpus is still a beginning.
draft.search_engine_description: Why I built a searchable library of the Hindu tradition I grew up with, and why a text layer is not the same as text.
